description: One round trip = renkeimap_find_system + renkeimap_status + renkeimap_hintpack. Give either a slug or a free-text query (system name); returns the resolved system, its current externally-observed status (same shape as renkeimap_status) and the static hint pack (same shape as renkeimap_hintpack). Use this first in support conversations; fall back to the single tools when you need only one part. ★Always relay the included disclaimer and citation★.

query.description: system name as the user wrote it, used when slug is unknown
